about: What can be mined and with what hardware. Used later to compare which coins are worth mining on a given machine; no evaluation happens yet. Prices come from the sources in each coin's price entry (CoinGecko ids checked on the asOf date).

hardware.cpu: General purpose processors; the algorithm is designed so CPUs are the efficient choice.
hardware.gpu: Graphics cards; memory hard or parallel algorithms where GPUs lead.
hardware.disk: Proof of space or storage: free disk space is the resource, the CPU only proves it.
hardware.other: Dominated by ASICs or FPGAs; a CPU or GPU earns next to nothing.

algorithms.name: RandomX
algorithms.memory: 2080 MiB dataset in fast mode, 256 MiB cache in light mode, 2 MiB scratchpad per thread
algorithms.notes: Random programs run in a virtual machine tuned to CPUs (large caches, branch prediction, floating point). GPUs run it far less efficiently.

algorithms.name: VerusHash 2.2
algorithms.notes: Built on AES instructions; CPUs with AES-NI lead, FPGAs were made uneconomical by version 2.2.

algorithms.name: GhostRider
algorithms.notes: Chains CryptoNight variants and the x16r hash family in a random order.

algorithms.name: XelisHash v2
algorithms.notes: Memory hard with a CPU friendly design; GPUs mine it too.

algorithms.name: KawPow
algorithms.notes: ProgPoW variant with a DAG that grows over time.

algorithms.name: FiroPoW
algorithms.notes: ProgPoW variant with a larger DAG.

algorithms.name: Etchash
algorithms.notes: Ethash with a slower growing DAG. ASICs exist.

algorithms.name: Autolykos v2
algorithms.notes: Memory hard, growing table.

algorithms.name: Octopus
algorithms.notes: Ethash style DAG algorithm.

algorithms.name: Blake3
algorithms.notes: Compute bound; ASICs have appeared.

algorithms.name: DynexSolve
algorithms.notes: Proof of useful work that simulates neuromorphic circuits.

algorithms.name: kHeavyHash
algorithms.notes: ASICs took over; GPU mining is no longer economical.

algorithms.name: SHA-256d
algorithms.notes: ASICs only in practice.

algorithms.name: Scrypt
algorithms.notes: ASICs only in practice; Dogecoin is merge mined with Litecoin.

algorithms.name: X11
algorithms.notes: ASICs only in practice.

algorithms.name: Equihash 200,9
algorithms.notes: ASICs only in practice.

algorithms.name: Proof of space and time
algorithms.notes: Plots written to disk once; farming reads them. Plotting is faster with a GPU.

algorithms.name: Proof of capacity
algorithms.notes: Plotted disk space answers each block's challenge.

algorithms.name: Proof of space-time (Spacemesh)
algorithms.notes: Space is initialized once, a GPU makes that fast; proofs then read the disk.

algorithms.name: Proof of archival storage
algorithms.notes: Farmers store pieces of the chain's history.

coins.name: Cryptoescudo
coins.notes: Portuguese Litecoin fork with a tiny network (about 50 kH/s, no ASICs): one GPU is many times the whole network, so the miner caps its share. No exchange lists it, so there is no price.
